info.name: RRV Green Basket - Order Service
info.description: Comprehensive Postman API Collection for RRV Green Basket Order Service (Port 8091 directly or Port 8080 via API Gateway). Covers checkout orchestration, cutoff operating window (8AM-9PM IST), next-day delivery scheduling, cart & inventory validation, stock reservations, COD auto-confirmation, customer tracking, cancellations, admin lifecycle management, and revenue analytics.

item.name: 22 - Verify next-day delivery scheduling date in order response
23 - Customer gets own order details
24 - Customer attempts to access another customer order (Rejected 403 Forbidden)
25 - Customer cancels eligible order in PLACED/CONFIRMED state
26 - Customer attempts invalid cancellation of DELIVERED order (Rejected 400)
27 - Admin gets all orders with filtering and pagination
28 - Admin updates order status (CONFIRMED -> PROCESSING)
29 - Admin attempts invalid status transition (PLACED -> DELIVERED direct)
30 - Verify complete order milestone status history
31 - Verify historical order snapshots do not change after zone updates
